exposure: Lack of involvement in the decision-making process
Antenatal birth classes that failed to include discussion of IoL
antenatal birth classes that included discussion of IoL
cohort: 1453 women who underwent induction of labor (IoL) with a live fetus and answered a questionnaire about their experience
finding: Determinants of maternal dissatisfaction with labor induction differed between nulliparous and parous women, but common factors included inadequate pain relief, lack of attention to requests, and severe maternal complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with dissatisfaction in both nulliparous and parous women.
